fragrances.name: Sauvage
fragrances.description: A bright, peppery bergamot blast over a big mineral-ambery ambroxan trail. Clean, loud and instantly recognizable, it reads modern and masculine in almost any setting.
cons: Ambroxan can feel sharp or synthetic

fragrances.name: Sauvage Elixir
fragrances.description: A dense, concentrated take on the Sauvage idea, swapping the airy freshness for cinnamon, cardamom, licorice and lavender over a rich woody-amber core. Dark, commanding and built for cool nights.
pros: One or two sprays is enough

fragrances.name: Dior Homme Intense
fragrances.description: A velvety, cocoa-tinged iris wrapped in soft pear and dry cedar. Refined and quietly seductive, like a tailored suit worn in candlelight.

fragrances.name: Fahrenheit
fragrances.description: An unconventional blend of violet leaf, leather and a faintly petrol-like warmth that has divided noses since the late eighties. Bold, textured and unmistakably its own thing.
cons: Can feel dated to younger noses

fragrances.name: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: Polished grapefruit and ginger settle into smooth sandalwood, cedar and a thread of incense. Confident and neat, it goes from boardroom to dinner without missing a beat.

fragrances.name: Allure Homme Sport
fragrances.description: Sparkling orange and sea air over a soft, creamy musk-and-tonka base. Fresh and energetic yet smooth, like a clean shirt after a morning swim.

fragrances.name: Y Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: Crisp apple and ginger over sage and a sweet, ambery-woody base. Modern, youthful and slick, with enough warmth to move from day into evening.

fragrances.name: La Nuit de L'Homme
fragrances.description: A soft, intimate cardamom-lavender blend with a whisper of cedar and vetiver. Smooth and seductive, made for close-up moments rather than filling a room.

fragrances.name: Acqua di Giò
fragrances.description: The archetypal nineties aquatic: zesty citrus and salty sea breeze softened by light florals and musk. Breezy, clean and effortless on a hot day.

fragrances.name: Acqua di Giò Profumo
fragrances.description: A darker, more grown-up aquatic where sea spray and herbs meet smoky incense and earthy patchouli. Fresh yet deep, like a coastline at dusk.
cons: Incense may feel heavy to some

fragrances.name: Eros
fragrances.description: Icy mint and green apple crash into a loud vanilla-tonka base. Sweet, fresh and flirtatious, it is built to be noticed on a night out.

fragrances.name: Dylan Blue Pour Homme
fragrances.description: A well-built blue fragrance of grapefruit, pepper and patchouli over a mineral musk base. Easy, fresh and dependable for everyday wear.

fragrances.name: Versace Pour Homme
fragrances.description: A light Mediterranean citrus with neroli, sage and a soft musky finish. Crisp, clean and unfussy, ideal for sunny days and warm offices.

fragrances.name: Prada L'Homme
fragrances.description: A crisp, soapy iris with neroli and a light amber-wood base, like freshly pressed linen. Understated sophistication that never shouts.

fragrances.name: Luna Rossa Carbon
fragrances.description: A cool, slightly metallic lavender and bergamot scent with a clean ambroxan finish. Sleek and technical, like fresh air in a modern design studio.

fragrances.name: 1 Million
fragrances.description: A sugary cinnamon-leather bomb with a candy-like amber glow. Flashy and fun, it belongs on the dance floor rather than in the boardroom.

fragrances.name: Invictus
fragrances.description: Juicy grapefruit and a salty sea-air accord over a sweet ambergris and guaiac-wood base. Sporty, upbeat and easy to like, it suits daytime outings and warm-weather socialising.

fragrances.name: Le Male
fragrances.description: A barbershop lavender and mint opening melts into a warm, creamy vanilla-tonka embrace. Nostalgic, cuddly and irresistibly sensual on cool evenings.

fragrances.name: Le Male Le Parfum
fragrances.description: A plush, elegant evolution of Le Male built on cardamom, lavender, iris and a rich vanilla. Smooth, dressy and deeply seductive.

fragrances.name: Le Beau
fragrances.description: A breezy, holiday-like blend of bergamot, creamy coconut and tonka. Sunny and playful, it smells like a beach bar at golden hour.

fragrances.name: Terre d'Hermès
fragrances.description: Bitter orange and flinty mineral notes over a dry vetiver and cedar base. Grounded, cerebral and quietly authoritative.
cons: Not a crowd-pleaser for younger noses

fragrances.name: Valentino Uomo Born in Roma
fragrances.description: Salty mineral freshness, ginger and violet leaf over smoky vetiver. Modern and stylish, with a street-smart edge.

fragrances.name: Azzaro Pour Homme
fragrances.description: A textbook aromatic fougère of lavender, anise, herbs and oakmoss. Clean-shaven barbershop confidence with an old-school gentleman's swagger.

fragrances.name: Legend
fragrances.description: A fresh, fruity fougère with pineapple and lavender over soft tonka and moss. Friendly and approachable, it is easy to reach for every day.

fragrances.name: Explorer
fragrances.description: A bright bergamot opening leads into earthy vetiver, patchouli and a soft woody-leather trail. Adventurous yet polished, a great everyday companion.
cons: Patchouli may be too earthy for some

fragrances.name: Boss Bottled
fragrances.description: Crisp apple and cinnamon over a smooth sandalwood-vanilla base. A dependable, well-groomed classic that suits almost any grown-up occasion.

fragrances.name: Boss The Scent
fragrances.description: Spicy ginger and an exotic, juicy fruit note over smooth, warm leather. Seductive and easygoing, designed for dates and evenings out.

fragrances.name: Light Blue Pour Homme
fragrances.description: A zingy grapefruit and mandarin splash with rosemary and a whisper of musk. Sunny, carefree and light as a Mediterranean holiday.

fragrances.name: The One for Men
fragrances.description: A smooth tobacco-amber blend lifted by grapefruit and warm spices. Cosy, suave and classic, like a well-cut suit by a fireplace.

fragrances.name: Spicebomb
fragrances.description: A fiery mix of cinnamon, chili and saffron over tobacco and leather. Hot, bold and dramatic, it suits winter nights and statement outfits.

fragrances.name: Man in Black
fragrances.description: Boozy rum and spices over supple leather and resinous tonka-benzoin. Dark, warm and luxurious, like a velvet armchair in a dim cocktail lounge.
pros: Feels more expensive than it is
